name: Eye&Head
summary: Gaze pointing that uses eye and head movement together: the eyes point, and head movement refines or confirms the selection.
howItWorks: The system separates eye-only gaze shifts from coordinated eye-head movements, letting users look around freely and use head motion to select or adjust the pointer.
